questions.question: How does Malachi 4 describe the coming day of the LORD?
options: A day of very great feasting and of much joy for every people and every nation upon the earth
Burning like an oven, but with the sun of righteousness rising with healing for those who fear God
Cool and very quiet, a day of deep rest and of gladness for all of the whole wide earth to share in
Dark and entirely silent, a day with no word at all coming forth from the mouth of the LORD
questions.answer: Burning like an oven, but with the sun of righteousness rising with healing for those who fear God
